desc: RISE Reliant Triggers enhance performance and offer easy installation, easy adjustment, and reliable safety for Remington 700 and Rem 700 clone bolt-action rifles. The Reliant Pro’s Easy-Access Adjustability allows you to easily adjust the trigger’s pull weight from 3 lbs. and its overtravel. Plus, Reliant triggers universally fit Rem 700 and clone actions. Simply select the option with the bolt release for true Remington 700 rifles, or the option without the bolt release for clone actions.
